title: Premium & upgrades
subtitle: Support Pixel Place with cosmetics and convenience — fairness comes first.
fairnessFallback: Premium gives cosmetics and convenience, not raw pixel speed. Optional cooldown tweaks stay capped.
upgradePremiumDesc: Extra cosmetic themes and included private canvas slots. Does not reduce pixel cooldown.
buyThemesDesc: Permanent bonus themes for the interface.
buyCooldownBoostDesc: Small placement cooldown reduction with a global floor — capped so paying never dominates skill.
buySlotDesc: Add another private canvas slot on top of your base allowance.
needsBackend: Set NEXT_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL so the app can reach billing on the PostgreSQL API.
loginRequired: Sign in with an account that uses the PostgreSQL backend to purchase or subscribe.
successHint: Perks may take a few seconds to apply — use Refresh if needed.
offUnavailable: This offer is not configured on the server (missing Stripe price id).
offersHint: Secure checkout opens in Stripe. You can manage renewals from Manage billing when available.
